newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman puts buy on Esprit.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman puts buy on Esprit.

text.p: Esprit Telecom Group Plc, a UK-based telephone company listed on the pan-European Easdaq market, was rated "buy" as Lehman Brothers began coverage of the stock.
Lehman set a discounted cash flow valuation of $15.63 per American depository share, a 30 percent premium to its current price.
"Customer focus and the ability to differentiate tariffs should give Esprit a clear competitive advantage over the incumbent operators," Lehman said.
"Its well-developed network, pan-European customer base and fast break-even in the UK make it in our view the most attractive of the start-up European operators."
